tasks.label: build sudoku (terminal)
tasks.command: mkdir -p build && /usr/bin/g++-15 -std=c++26 -Wall -Wextra -g -fdiagnostics-color=always -I '${workspaceFolder}' -I '${workspaceFolder}/ui/Terminal' core/*.cpp app/*.cpp main.cpp ui/Terminal/TerminalUI.cpp -o build/sudoku

tasks.label: build sudoku (qt6)
tasks.command: mkdir -p build && /usr/lib/qt6/libexec/moc -I '${workspaceFolder}' ui/QT/MainWindow.hpp -o build/moc_MainWindow.cpp && { [ -s build/moc_MainWindow.cpp ] || : > build/moc_MainWindow.cpp; } && /usr/lib/qt6/libexec/moc -I '${workspaceFolder}' ui/QT/QCell.hpp -o build/moc_QCell.cpp && { [ -s build/moc_QCell.cpp ] || : > build/moc_QCell.cpp; } && /usr/bin/g++-15 -std=c++20 -Wall -Wextra -g -fPIC -fdiagnostics-color=always -DQT_UI -I '${workspaceFolder}' -I '${workspaceFolder}/ui/QT' $(pkg-config --cflags Qt6Widgets) core/*.cpp app/*.cpp main.cpp ui/QT/MainWindow.cpp ui/QT/QCell.cpp build/moc_MainWindow.cpp build/moc_QCell.cpp -o build/sudoku-qt $(pkg-config --libs Qt6Widgets)
